column1: # The models the first sweep did not run that need a CARD TO THEMSELVES, added
# 2026-09-07 to complete the before/after-training pairs the paper's comparison
# needs. recogdrive_il is the fourth and lives in models_il.tsv, because at 2B it
# shares a card and this fleet's rows do not.
#   simwam_base      SimWAM before FlowGRPO. Pairs with simwam (= SimWAM-RL).
#   mtdrive_sft      Qwen2.5-VL-7B text-out planner, the SFT stage.
#   mtdrive_mtgrpo   the same after mtGRPO. The two pair with each other.
# (The fourth pair, DiffusionDrive vs DiffusionDrive+BeyondDrive, the first
# sweep already has -- that one is augmentation rather than an RL stage.)
# simwam_base needs 12.6 GiB and each mtdrive stage ~15 GiB, so none of them
# fits beside the renderer. Two cards, all 54 scenarios.
# The env vars are paths the adapters would otherwise take from constants under
# /bigdata, which this cluster does not mount. mtdrive needs none: its
# checkpoint is a stage DIRECTORY and it reads nothing from the environment.
